During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a group of escaped [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] went into hiding on the dangerous [[Rryatt Trail]] — a long and winding trail through the enormous forests of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

They found a place on the [[Rryatt Trail#High Grounds|High Grounds]], high dirt-covered rock formations that rose to enormous heights amidst the giant [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]]. Here, the Wookiees built several primitive huts where they lived in hiding from [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
